title: MONEYLOG 2.5.3
notes: Made update checks resilient to browser and service-worker cache behavior with a fresh release manifest request
Update now now waits for the new service worker to control the current tab before reloading
Added a direct app-shell refresh fallback so one update does not require closing and reopening MONEYLOG
Changed update reminders to a 1-day interval after Remind me later
Logged-in MONEYLOG sessions now recheck for releases automatically while the app is open
